metadata.task: Carry the medical tray carefully without disturbing the instruments.

plan.goal: Navigate to the Medical Supply Store, pick up the medical tray, and transport it to the General Ward without disturbing the instruments.

grounded_skills.reason: To pick up the tray without disturbing instruments, the robot needs a precise 3D pose estimate. The robot has depth perception and object detection capabilities.

checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the medical tray.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot has a parallel gripper and dexterous hand capabilities (can_pick, can_grasp). It uses MoveIt2 to plan a trajectory to grasp the tray.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the General Ward with the medical tray.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the medical tray at the Medical Supply Store.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the General Ward holding the tray.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot must transport the tray to the destination. It navigates to the General Ward while carrying the load.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the medical tray on a designated surface in the General Ward.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the General Ward holding the tray.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has placed the medical tray on a surface in the General Ward.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot has the capability to place objects (can_place). It moves the tray to a stable pose on a surface in the General Ward.

constraints: Robot is single-arm only (cannot use two hands).

execution_summary.expected_outcome: The robot successfully navigates to the Medical Supply Store, detects and estimates the pose of the medical tray, picks it up carefully, transports it to the General Ward, and places it down without disturbing the instruments.
